en: Heroes of the sea, noble people,
O Homeland, is felt the voice
that shall guide you to victory!
Over the land, over the sea,
in the living light of your sky!
Let Europe cry out to the whole earth:
by the ocean, roaring with love,
gave new worlds to the world!
Over the land, over the sea,
Salute the Sun that is rising
let the echo of an affront
be the signal to rise again.
Over the land, over the sea,
notes: line 2.2: 'sente-se a voz' is 'the voice is felt' or 'one hears the voice'.
line 2.3: 'avós' is literally 'grandparents', here 'forefathers, ancestors'; 'egrégios' is 'illustrious, eminent'.
line 4.1: 'Desfralda' is addressed to the Homeland ('unfurl', singular).
lines 5.1-5.2: the original order is 'Kisses your joyful soil / the ocean, roaring with love': the ocean is the subject. 'jucundo' is 'joyful, pleasant'.
line 7.3: 'afronta' is an affront or insult: the echo of an insult is to be the signal of rising again.
